name: Lagos Teenage Police
source:
Kofi Karma is a 17 year old police officer from Lagos, Nigeria. Thanks to his special ability, he can see when someone is lying.


[Translated from [url=https://patla.itch.io/lagos-teenage-police]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
科菲·卡尔玛 (Kofi Karma) 是一名来自尼日利亚拉各斯的17岁警官。由于他的特殊能力，他可以看出有人在说谎。


[译自[url=https://patla.itch.io/lagos-teenage-police]itch.io[/url]]
